home.heroSubtitle: I spend my professional life solving complex problems and my personal life looking for harder ones.
home.professionalSubtitle: Enterprise Technical Architecture Director, focused on end-to-end enterprise architecture for global organizations.
home.personalSubtitle: PADI Divemaster, mountaineer, skier and traveler, 58 of 195 countries and counting.
home.quote: Every step before this one led me here. I could never have imagined how fortunate I would be to experience all of this and meet so many interesting people along the way. Every step, every breath, every experience has shaped me and let me think bigger than ever before, always seeking what this beautiful world has to give.

about.accentLine: Architect by profession. Adventurer by instinct.
about.locationLine: A global citizen, always on the move across time zones.
about.p1: For more than a decade, I have been helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through technology. My career has been built at the intersection of enterprise architecture, strategic consulting, and hands-on engineering, transforming ambitious business objectives into scalable, practical solutions that deliver measurable value.
about.p2: As an <1>Enterprise Technical Architecture Director</1>, I partner with executives, business leaders, and delivery teams to design enterprise-scale digital transformation programs, with a focus on end-to-end enterprise architecture. My expertise spans Salesforce architecture, Quote-to-Cash, Revenue Lifecycle Management, CRM strategy, system integration, cloud platforms, and enterprise solution design across industries including Financial Services, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, SaaS, Analytics, and Professional Services.
about.p3: I believe great architecture is never just about technology. It's about understanding people, aligning stakeholders, simplifying complexity, and creating systems that remain adaptable for years to come.
about.journey: I consider myself a global citizen. I've lived and worked in Silicon Valley, California; London, UK; Zurich, Switzerland; and San Francisco, California, calling several countries home along the way. Each move meant starting a new life from scratch in a new country, which has made me highly adaptable and resilient, and given me a natural ease connecting with people from any background.
about.leadIntro: The way I lead has been shaped just as much outside the office as inside it.
about.divemaster: As a <1>PADI Divemaster</1>, I've learned that preparation, calm decision-making, and trust are essential when leading people in challenging environments. Overcoming fear starts in your head, and you simply never give up.
about.mountaineer: As a <1>mountaineer</1>, I've experienced that meaningful achievements are built one deliberate step at a time. Success comes from resilience, planning, and adapting when conditions inevitably change, because everything is in your head: you face your fears and never give up.
about.marathon: As a <1>marathon runner</1>, I've learned that consistency outperforms intensity. Long-term results come from discipline, persistence, and continuous improvement rather than quick wins. It's proof that everything is in your head: overcome the fear, and never give up.
about.continents: Having <1>lived and worked across three continents</1>, I've developed a global perspective that allows me to collaborate effectively with diverse teams, understand different business cultures, and build strong relationships across organisations.
about.closing: Because the best solutions don't simply solve today's problems. They create opportunities for tomorrow.
